Designed recovery resolution

Verified and promoted v0.9 recovery release changes and documentation

I’ve fixed the v0.10 safety shape before coding it: **resolution will not mean “the old operation failed.”** It will mean “a human explicitly abandoned replay, moved the ambiguous orphan out of the active staging surface into a quarantine subdirectory, and Actor Engine independently verified the original is absent and the quarantined bytes/hash exist.” Only that durable resolution evidence can clear the preflight block.

That keeps three facts separate: historical outcome stays unknown; ambiguous bytes get a verified disposition; future proposal admission can reopen without reviving the old proposal.
